compile_inputs: result collection type: SET/ORDERED/MULTISET/WEIGHTED/other explicit type

stages.name: semantic_compile
stages.rule: Produce backend-independent typed query semantics before physical planning.

stages.name: closure_check
stages.rule: KNOWN_INVALID recomputes/rejects; UNKNOWN broadens, instruments, recomputes or defers consequential operations.

stages.name: admission_class
stages.rule: Declare whether result must be authoritative exact, exact derived, approximate candidate, salience-only or model-internal.

stages.name: logical_subplan_enumeration
stages.rule: Enumerate exact, relational, graph, vector, FTS, activation and hybrid routes preserving TCQS semantics.

stages.name: hard_constraint_prune
stages.rule: Remove plans violating required transaction domain, source epochs, result type, selection integrity, rebuild or protected-resource boundaries.

stages.name: placement_optimize
stages.rule: Choose transaction/data/index/compute/process/fault placement independently; cost optimization may not weaken semantic or recovery requirements.

stages.name: execute
stages.rule: Execute selected polyglot subplans; record exact physical plan and source/index epochs.

stages.name: selection_receipt
stages.rule: Bind authorized search space, predicates, collection algebra, ranking/truncation/tie policy, candidate set and selector identity.

stages.name: result_admission
stages.rule: Approximate or salience results remain candidates/priors; consequential exact claims require declared validation rather than implicit lifting.

stages.name: cognitive_handoff
stages.rule: If model-facing, bind system WorkspaceEpisode and exact reader projection separately from model-internal uptake.

stages.name: effect_time_check
stages.rule: Revalidate operation-relevant basis and current release conditions before consequential external effect.

stages.name: outcome_append_and_derive
stages.rule: Append canonical outcome/re-entry, then incrementally update graph/vector/FTS/activation views with derivation receipts.

routing_defaults.temporal_provenance: canonical event/time index; no ANN substitution
routing_defaults.graph_relation: ClayGraph or typed graph-relational lowering with source-epoch receipt
routing_defaults.vector_similarity: ANN candidate route plus exact metadata/source validation when consequential
routing_defaults.full_text: FTS candidate route; tokenizer/analyzer version bound
routing_defaults.mixed_query: compose in one logical plan; physical compute may fuse while data/index storage remains separate
routing_defaults.protected_external_resource: reference only; current release handled outside cognitive data stores

physical_placement_policy.prefer_same_process_compute_when: measured cross-modal query affinity and boundary cost dominate without increasing unacceptable fault coupling
physical_placement_policy.prefer_decoupled_index_or_data_when: specialized layout/compression/update behavior materially reduces overhead or preserves replaceability
physical_placement_policy.prefer_single_transaction_domain_when: multiple writes are jointly authoritative for one effect-critical state transition
physical_placement_policy.prefer_durable_derivation_log_when: heterogeneous non-authoritative views can tolerate explicit lag and must be replayable
physical_placement_policy.never_infer: semantic unification alone never decides physical colocation

validation_hooks: source epoch and derivation program version
